item.title: ❗️ Today, during the daytime, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to carry out strikes using unmanned aerial vehicles against logistics centres, port infrastructur
item.description: ❗️ Today, during the daytime, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to carry out strikes using unmanned aerial vehicles against logistics centres, port infrastructure facilities in Ukraine, and vessels involved in the delivery of military cargo to Ukraine. 💥 As a result of the strike, a logistics centre in Ternovka of Nikolayev region was hit. It stored military and dual-use cargo intended to support the AFU. 🔥 In addition, a dry cargo ship delivering military cargo to the port of Chernomorsk was hit while underway at sea. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29971

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
⚡️
Units of the Sever Group of Forces in Kharkov region continue
to tighten the encirclement and expand the external control zone.
🚩
In the encirclement, Russian troops took under control Reznikovo and Kupino in Kharkov region.
🔥
Fights are underway in the encirclement
for the liberation of Nikolayevka, Varvarovka, Nefedovka, and Chernoye (Kharkov region).
▪️
Over 65 servicemen and two unmanned ground vehicles have been neutralised in the encirclement during the day.
📍
Russian troops expand the external control zone.
Fights continue for Prikolotnoye, Kotovka, and Gogino in Kharkov region.
💥
In Kharkov region
, manpower and hardware of four mechanised brigades, a motorised infantry brigade, an artillery brigade, an assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and a territorial defence brigade have been hit near Timofeyevka, Khotomlya, Izbitskoye, Dergachi, Goryanoye, Revolyutsionnoye, and Velikiy Burluk (Kharkov region).
🔥
In Sumy region
, strikes were delivered at formations of two mechanised brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and three territorial defence brigades close to Vorozhba, Velikaya Rybitsa, Vakalovshchina, Barilovka, and Khoten (Sumy region).
▪️
In total, the enemy lost more than 270 troops, 10 motor vehicles, and one radar reconnaissance station in the area of responsibility of the Sever Group of Forces.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line
and inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of four mechanised brigades, an assault brigade of the AFU, a marine brigade, and a territorial defence brigade near Maleyevka, Peski-Radkovskiye, Grushevka, Novonikolayevka, Volchiy Yar, and Kapitolovka (Kharkov region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 200 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, 12 motor vehicles, one artillery gun, and one electronic warfare station.
↗️
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions
. Russian units inflicted damage on formations of two mechanised brigades, a motorised infantry brigade, an airmobile brigade, a mountain assault brigade, and an unmanned systems brigade of the AFU close to Druzhkovka, Novoselovka, Belokuzminovka, Semenovka, Kramatorsk, Vysokoivanovka, and Slavyansk (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 160 troops, 21 motor vehicles, and one field artillery gun.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29972

🎖
🎖
by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation
as of 11 October 2026
Part 2 (
👉
see
Part 1
)
🚩
As a result of resolute actions, the Tsentr Group of Forces liberated Novotroitskoye and Petrovskoye in the Donetsk People's Republic
.
💥
Russian troops
engaged manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, a marine brigade, and two national guard brigades close to Novoyavlenka, Roganskoye, Svyatogorovka, Belozerskoye, Veselaya Gora (Donetsk People's Republic), Demurino, and Tarasovka (Dnepropetrovsk region).
⚡️
In Dobropolye (Donetsk People's Republic)
, the 51st Army's assault groups have advanced in the central and northern-western parts of the city. Marine units continued to mop up the western quarters of the city and the territory of the Doborpolskaya mine. An enemy's attempt to unblock the AFU surrendered units by a force of up to a platoon with the support of armoured vehicles was thwarted.
📊
Over the past 24 hours, 137 buildings
, including three production facilities, have been liberated. Up to 30 troops, two armoured vehicles, and one pickup truck have been neutralised.
▪️
In total, up to 495 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, 14 motor vehicles, and four electronic warfare stations have been neutralised in the Tsentr Group's area of responsibility.
↗️
The Vostok Group of Forces continued to advance into the depths of the enemy's defence
. Russian troops inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, an assault brigade, three air assault brigades, two assault regiments of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one marine brigade close to Orestopol, Ivanovka, Velikomikhaylovka, Skotovatoye, Medichnoye in Dnepropetrovsk region, Volnyanka, and Mirolyubovka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 230 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, seven motor vehicles, and one field artillery gun.
📍
The Dnepr Group's units took more advantageous lines and positions
. Russian element hit formations of a mechanised brigade, a mountain assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and a territorial defence brigade close to Orekhov, Preobrazhenka, and Novoaleksandrovka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
More than 50 troops, 23 motor vehicles, and two electronic warfare stations were neutralised.
✈️
Operational-tactical aviation, attack drones, missile troops and artillery of the Russian Groups of Forces
have inflicted damage on the transport infrastructure and energy facilities of Ukraine used in the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, the production workshops of unmanned aerial vehicles and their launching sites as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 147 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
two guided aerial bombs and 909 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.
📊
In total
, since the beginning of the special military operation,
the enemy has lost:
▫️
674
aircraft,
▫️
284
helicopters,
▫️
259,174
drones,
▫️
672
anti-aircraft missile systems,
▫️
31,190
tanks and other armoured fighting vehicles,
▫️
1,786
MLRS fighting vehicles,
▫️
36,691
field artillery and mortars,
▫️
74,230
support military vehicles.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
